about: [O5] The gym's bout, profile medium (brief O5 §3: idle / bad / medium / good): E at the man by the ring, the bout (the base's fist fight, the stand-in for O4's), its end: the purse or out of the ring.

steps.eval: (() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('gym'), F = s.frame; const p = F.w(0, -1.6); G.stage.part('stream').warmAround(p.x, p.z); N.controller.setPose(p.x, p.z, F.yaw(0), -0.05); return 1; })()

steps.walk: (() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('gym'), F = s.frame, K = s.live.K; const p = F.w(K.man.x - 1.2, K.man.z + 0.9); return [[p.x, p.z]]; })()

steps.eval: (() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('gym'), F = s.frame, K = s.live.K; const a = F.v(K.man.x, 1.8, K.man.z); const C = N.controller; C.yaw = Math.atan2(-(a.x - G.eye.x), -(a.z - G.eye.z)); C.pitch = 0; window.__m0 = G.save.money || 0; return 1; })()

JSON.stringify({ wins: G.city.places.byId.get('gym').state.wins || 0, money: (G.save.money || 0) - window.__m0, downs: G.brawl.stats && G.brawl.stats.downs, time: G.brawl.stats && +G.brawl.stats.time.toFixed(1), warned: G.brawl.stats && G.brawl.stats.downWarned })
